title: AccessAlertStateSettledPayload
description: Payload of the AccessAlertStateSettled event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-REQ-895; class: domain): the settled state of the ACC-001 alert of one entity. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

accCode.description: The catalogued ACC alert code; only ACC-001 is settled by this event.

entityRef.description: The entity the alert concerns: the same value as the entity of the scope entity:<entityRef> of AccessAlertRaised.

state.description: RAISED while the entity has no active tax.approver, CLEARED once it has one again.

stateVersion.description: Strictly increasing per entity and code, so a consumer ignores a stale or repeated event.
